# Version 4.152.0
> **Graphite and Skia m152** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.152.0-preview)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.152.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.152.0 preview 1 introduces Graphite, async pixel readback, and the Skia m152 engine. The preview also expands Vulkan integration, adds Nano Server font support, fixes native lifetime hazards, and streamlines several managed and I/O hot paths.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m152** — Moves the bundled renderer to Chrome milestone 152 after incorporating the final upstream stability updates from the m151 line. ([#4651](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4651), [#4568](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4568), [#4538](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4538), [#4537](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4537))

## API Surface

- **Graphite GPU bindings added** — Exposes Skia's next-generation GPU backend for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3968](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3968))
- **Async pixel readback added** — SKImage and SKSurface can request pixel data asynchronously through a backend-neutral API. ([#4545](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4545))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Native-backed pixel and region lifetimes corrected** — Keeps source objects alive while iterators, subsets, and transformed pixmaps use their native memory, and releases raster buffers when image creation fails. ([#4355](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4355), [#4558](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4558), [#4455](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4455))
- **Managed and I/O hot paths streamlined** — Reduces repeated reflection, buffer copying, temporary strings, and uniform-map resizing in commonly used operations. ([#4630](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4630), [#4550](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4550), [#4498](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4498), [#4512](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4512))

## Platform

- **Vulkan integration expanded** — Adds a SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package for applications using Silk.NET's Vulkan bindings. ([#4527](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4527))
- **Nano Server font support added** — Uses FreeType so text rendering can discover and load fonts on Windows Nano Server. — ❤️ [@jeffska](https://github.com/jeffska) ([#4280](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4280))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1

No HarfBuzzSharp binding changes shipped in this release — it rebuilds the same HarfBuzz as the previous line.
